package rulefixtures

import (
	gorm "gorm.io/gorm"
)

// scenario for find_all_then_manual_paginate_in_go: All rows fetched and then sliced in Go instead of using database-level pagination.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: data_access; severity: contextual.
type Rule262PositiveRecord struct {
	ID       int
	TenantID int
	Name     string
}

func scenario262Positive(db *gorm.DB, tenantID, offset, limit int) ([]Rule262PositiveRecord, error) {
	var allItems []Rule262PositiveRecord
	if err := db.Where("tenant_id = ?", tenantID).Find(&allItems).Error; err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	end := offset + limit
	if end > len(allItems) {
		end = len(allItems)
	}
	return allItems[offset:end], nil
}
